title: BillOfLading
description:
A bill of lading: a document issued by a carrier evidencing a transport
contract and the receipt of goods for shipment. First version, aligned to
the UNVTD bill of lading credential subject
(https://unvtd.unece.org/bill-of-lading-schema.yaml)

billOfLadingNumber.description:
The bill of lading number, identifying the transport contract
x-json-ld-property: https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/identifier

documentIdentifier.description:
A further reference identifying this specific document, when it
differs from the bill of lading number (UNVTD `documentIdentifier`).

bookingReferenceNumber.description: The booking reference assigned by the carrier to the consignment

issueDate.description: The date the bill of lading was issued (UNVTD `issueDate`).

consignmentLoadingDate.description: The date the consignment was loaded onto the means of transport

estimatedTimeOfDeparture.description: The scheduled departure of the means of transport

estimatedTimeOfArrival.description: The estimated arrival of the means of transport

consignor.description:
The party consigning the goods as stipulated in the transport contract.
x-json-ld-property: https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/consignorParty

consignee.description:
The party to which the goods are consigned (UNVTD `consignee`).
x-json-ld-property: https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/consigneeParty

carrier.description:
The party providing the transport of the goods between named points.
x-json-ld-property: https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/carrierParty

notifyParty.description:
The party to be notified of the shipment (UNVTD `notifyParty`).
x-json-ld-property: https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/notifyParty

freightPayer.description: The party responsible for paying the freight charges

originalLoadingLocation.description: The location where the goods were loaded onto the means of

baseportUnloadingLocation.description: The place or port at which the cargo is discharged

deliveryLocation.description: The location to which the consignment is delivered to the final

placeOfDeparture.description: The port from which the means of transport departs

arrivalLocation.description: The port at which the means of transport arrives

paymentLocation.description: The place where the freight payment has been or is to be made

placeOfIssue.description: The location where the document was issued.

conveyanceReferenceNumber.description:
The journey identifier of the means of transport, such as the
voyage number

transportMeansIdentifier.description: The name of the means of transport, such as the vessel name.

transportMeansRegistration.description: The registration of the means of transport, such as the IMO number

containerSizeAndType.description: The code for the size and type of the transport equipment

fullOrEmptyContainer.description:
The code specifying how full the transport equipment is, e.g. `5`
for full.

transportEquipmentIdentifier.description:
The identifier of the transport equipment, such as the container
number .

sealIdentifier.description:
The identification number of the seal affixed to the transport
equipment.

grossWeight.description:
The total gross weight of the consignment including packaging
(UNVTD `grossWeight`).

volume.description: The total volume of the consignment

descriptionOfGoods.description:
The plain language description of the goods
(UNVTD `descriptionOfGoods`).

consignmentSummaryDescription.description: The summary description of the consignment

shippingMarks.description: The marks and numbers on the transport units or packages

transportContractConditions.description: The reference to the carrier's conditions of carriage

collectCharges.description: The charges to be collected from the consignee

contractNumber.description: The identifier of the underlying trade contract

goods.description: The goods covered by the bill of lading (UNVTD `goods`).
